design: Matched candidate control targets and identical controller logic. Candidate NPY files are byte-identical; recorded approach/closure/clamp/lift/hold targets are compared at matching physical times. Only runtime object mass is changed. The unchanged release policy computes retreat from measured held-object pose, so its realized retreat direction can differ with load. New success and display choices come from fresh 200 g physics, without new controller tuning or mass-specific synthesis.
control_array_comparison_scope: Approach through end of postlift hold, excluding release. Feedback-dependent release-retreat outputs are intentionally not required to be frame-identical.
pairing: Both input SHA-256 and template/scene/filename suffix must match. The path suffix disambiguates any duplicate numerical payload.
sampling_limit: Lift stability uses the same saved trace sampling and exact boundaries in both loads; postlift-hold gates use every physics step. This comparison adds no observation between saved lift samples.
